title: Chapter test: Cargo and Crates.io
summary: Eight questions on profiles, documentation, publishing and workspaces. You need 70% to pass; you can retry and your best score is kept.

questions.q: Where do you set `opt-level = 1` for debug builds?
questions.explanation: dev is the profile for cargo build.

questions.q: Integer overflow in a release build by default...
questions.explanation: Debug builds panic; release builds wrap unless you enable overflow-checks.

questions.q: Which runs the code in a `# Examples` section of a doc comment?
What does a doc comment section titled `# Errors` describe?
options: When and which errors a function returning Result produces
To give users simple paths and a clear docs front page, without reorganizing the code
questions.explanation: Internal layout and public API can differ.

questions.q: A version published to crates.io can be deleted with `cargo yank`.
questions.explanation: Yanking only stops new projects from choosing it.

questions.q: Two workspace members both depend on `rand`. Which versions do they get?
options: The same one, because of the shared Cargo.lock
Neither: workspaces cannot use external crates

questions.q: Which tool flags `let x = 3.1415;` and suggests a constant?
questions.explanation: Clippy has a lint for approximate constants.
